access.notes: Obtainable from the ICSD or published crystallographic data (Kimata 1983, Z. Kristallogr. 163, 295). Lattice parameters a=7.996 Å, c=5.152 Å, space group P-42₁m. The agent may also construct the structure from known atomic positions.

resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source DFT code with DFT+U capability)

access.notes: The agent must use a DFT code that supports GGA+U and spin-orbit coupling. Quantum ESPRESSO is recommended; other codes (VASP, Abinit, etc.) are acceptable as long as they reproduce the qualitative trends.
Efficiency-recommended PBE pseudopotentials for all elements (Sr, Mg, Si, O, Eu) from the SSSP library. Comparable PBE pseudopotential sets are acceptable.
